The '''Voss commando outpost''', also known as '''Camp Isah-No''' or '''Camp Talen-Ki''', was an outpost built by the [[Voss commandos]] atop [[Koss Overlook]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].
